description: Source file implementing utility functions for flash attention support on XPU, including hardware support checks, datatype validation, layout checks, and overall feasibility for flash attention.

methods.name: is_flash_attention_available
methods.description: Checks if flash attention is available on the current hardware.

methods.name: is_flash_attention_available
methods.description: Inline overload that checks flash attention availability with debug option.

methods.name: check_flash_attention_hardware_support
methods.description: Verifies if the current XPU device supports flash attention based on architecture.

methods.name: check_flash_attention_datatype
methods.description: Validates that query, key, and value tensors have supported data types (bfloat16 or half).

methods.name: check_flash_attention_head_dim_size
methods.description: Ensures q, k, v tensors have the same last dimension and within supported size.

methods.name: check_flash_attention_layout
methods.description: Checks the layout of attention tensors.

methods.name: check_flash_causal_non_square_seqlens
methods.description: Ensures causal attention with non-square sequence lengths is supported.

methods.name: check_flash_attention_deterministic
methods.description: Checks if the current context enforces deterministic algorithms.

methods.name: can_use_flash_attention
methods.description: Aggregates all checks to determine if flash attention can be used with given parameters.
